newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean soldier kills three colleagues.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean soldier kills three colleagues.

text.p: Three South Korean soldiers were killed and one was seriously injured on Tuesday when an army corporal opened fire at random in an army barracks near the border with North Korea, an army spokesman said.
The spokesman said Kim Yong-shik, 21, fired about 20 shots at colleagues in the barracks after his duty at a guard post on the country's eastern border area.
Kim surrendered hours after deserting the barracks, the spokesman said. Military authorities were investigating the case, he said.
In a similar incident on Sept. 22, a South Korean army private opened fire at random wounding nine soldiers before deserting his barracks near the border.
